messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed reduced motion for both the cards and win banner. Card border transitions and the victory pulse now turn off when the system requests reduced motion; the normal animations remain available otherwise. The styles also respond if the preference changes while the game is open.

The build and all 138 unit tests passed. All three focused motion browser checks passed. The full browser suite passed 75 checks, with two unrelated artwork and score-persistence checks timing out; both timed out again when retried separately. The project-wide formatting check also reported issues in 13 unchanged files.
